arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import re

people = [
    ('Tom Ridge', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Ridge'),
    ('Michael Chertoff', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Chertoff'),
    ('Janet Napolitano', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janet_Napolitano'),
    ('Jeh Johnson', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeh_Johnson'),
    ('John F. Kelly', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_F._Kelly'),
    ('Kirstjen Nielsen', 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirstjen_Nielsen'),
]

for name, url in people:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        html = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        # Look for education section or bachelor's info
        # Try to find the infobox education field
        edu_match = re.search(r'Education.*?>(.*?)<', html, re.DOTALL)
        if edu_match:
            print(f'{name}: {edu_match.group(1)[:200]}')
        else:
            # Try alma mater
            alma_match = re.search(r'Alma mater.*?>(.*?)<', html, re.DOTALL)
            if alma_match:
                print(f'{name}: {alma_match.group(1)[:200]}')
            else:
                # Search for bachelor
                bach_match = re.search(r'(bachelor[^<]+)', html, re.IGNORECASE)
                if bach_match:
                    print(f'{name}: {bach_match.group(1)[:200]}')
                else:
                    print(f'{name}: No education info found')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: Error - {e}')
" 2>&1
